patterns.note: Alternating full-width solid color background sections (vibrant orange and off-white) create strong visual breaks and define content blocks.
Extremely large, condensed sans-serif typography is used for all major section headings, creating a bold, editorial statement.
A single vibrant orange (#d64f29) is used as a dominant background color for key sections, providing a strong brand identity and energy.
A sticky header containing the 'dola' logo and 'MENU' button remains fixed at the top after the initial hero section scrolls out of view.
Content sections are revealed by sliding up from the bottom of the viewport as the user scrolls down the page.
Product grids are consistently presented in either a 2-column or 4-column layout, showcasing items with clear imagery and minimal text.

technique_notes: The site uses a sticky header that initially includes a large brand statement alongside the logo, then condenses to just the logo and navigation menu after scrolling past the hero section.
Content sections are presented with full-width solid color backgrounds, alternating between a vibrant orange and a light off-white, creating strong visual breaks and a modular structure.
Large, condensed display typography is used for all major section headings, creating a strong, editorial feel that contrasts sharply with smaller, more functional body text.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very large, bold, condensed sans-serif headings (up to ~5-6x body text size) with smaller, regular-weight sans-serif body text.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp, with no visible rounded corners on elements or images.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with ample vertical padding between full-width sections and consistent, moderate spacing within product grids.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its bold, almost brutalist use of a single vibrant orange as a dominant background color, combined with extremely large, condensed display typography for section headings. This creates a powerful, energetic, and editorial feel that elevates it beyond a typical e-commerce store.
